# Merging parallel feature branches — albdf M10 case study (2026-08-06)

Merging four parallel `m10/*` branches (rtl-crossline-search, core-redaction,
infra-fuzz, fix-render-args) into `main` with `git merge --no-ff`, then running
the full local gate on the merged tree. Three concrete lessons, all real hits.

## 1. Auto-generated files: regenerate, don't hand-merge

`REPO_MAP.md` (generated by `scripts/gen-repo-map.py`) conflicted on EVERY
merge — each branch regenerated it and touched different rows. Hand-merging
is wrong: the file is deterministic output of the generator. Resolution:

```bash
python3 scripts/gen-repo-map.py        # regenerates from the merged tree
git add REPO_MAP.md && git commit      # completes the merge
```

Rule: if a conflicting file is GENERATED, run its generator against the merged
tree instead of editing conflict markers. Works for REPO_MAP.md, lockfiles,
manifests, any deterministic index.

## 2. Conflict resolution in CMakeLists can leave orphaned fragments

Two branches each added a test-suite block (`UnitTestsRedact`,
`UnitTestsRender`) to `src/UnitTests/CMakeLists.txt` — both at the same
location. The resolution must KEEP BOTH blocks (additive, not either/or).
The danger: a naive "take both" edit can leave a dangling fragment — in this
case an extra `set_target_properties(...)` body with no opening — producing:

```
CMake Error at UnitTests/CMakeLists.txt:278:
  Parse error.  Expected "(", got identifier with text "OFF".
```

This is caught ONLY by re-running configure (`ci/run-ci.sh` stage 1), not by
eyeballing the file. Lesson: after ANY conflict resolution in build files,
run the full gate — configure + build + ctest — before declaring the merge
good. A "clean" `git status` does not mean the merged tree compiles.

## 3. `ci/run-ci.sh` merge-context: keep ALL exclusions / all suites

The fix-render branch's gate-fix added `grep -vE` exclusions for
`pdfutils.cpp` + `pdftoolrender.cpp` to `ci/run-ci.sh`; core-redaction's
added `pdfdocumentbuilder.cpp`. At merge these are ADDITIVE — resolve by
keeping every exclusion line, not the conflict side that "looks newer".
Same for the two `add_test(NAME UnitTestsRedact/Render ...)` blocks in
CMakeLists: both must survive. Verify the merged gate checks 40+ authored
files and both suites register (`ctest -N` shows UnitTestsRedact AND
UnitTestsRender), then confirm 14/14 green.

## Gate-verify after merge (the actual sequence that caught #2)

```bash
bash ci/run-ci.sh > /tmp/ci-run-main-merged.log 2>&1; echo "GATE_EXIT=$?"
# configure FAILED / build FAILED → grep the log for the CMake parse error
# fix, commit, re-run — merged main must be ALL GREEN before push/PR
```

First merged-gate run FAILED (CMake parse), fix committed as
`fix(merge): remove orphaned set_target_properties fragment`, second run
ALL GREEN (Release 14/14, ASAN green, format OK 41 files).
